SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.CASH_NUM AS cashNum,/**现金流序号**/ a.VDATE_UNADJUST AS vdateUnadjust,/**未调整的计算开始日**/ a.MDATE_UNADJUST AS mdateUnadjust,/**未调整的计算结束日**/ a.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST AS payDateUnadjust,/**未调整的计划支付日**/ a.VDATE AS vdate,/**调整后的计算开始日**/ a.MDATE AS mdate,/**调整后的计算结束日**/ a.PAY_DATE AS payDate,/**调整后的计划支付日**/ a.TERMDAYS AS termdays,/**计算周期天数**/ a.VDATE_Y AS vdateY,/**理论计息年度开始日**/ a.VDATE_TERM AS vdateTerm,/**完整周期开始日**/ a.MDATE_TERM AS mdateTerm,/**完整周期结束日**/ a.TERMDAYS_TERM termdaysTerm,/**完整周期计息天数**/ a.PRIN_AMT AS prinAmt,/**计划支付本金**/ a.IS_PAY_INT AS isPayInt,/**是否支付利息**/ a.INT_AMT AS intAmt,/**计划支付利息**/ a.CASH_AMT AS cashAmt,/**计划支付现金流**/ a.CASH_UNIT_TYPE AS cashUnitType,/**现金流单位**/ a.CALC_FUNCTION AS calcFunction,/**计息算法**/ a.FREQUENCY AS frequency,/**年付息次数**/ a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType,/**金融产品类型**/ a.PAY_TYPE AS payType, /**支付方式**/ b.BRANCH AS branch,/**分支序号**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2 /**现金流二级类型**/ ,a.INT_PRIN_AMT intPrinAmt /**计息本金**/ FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.PAY_STATUS = #{payStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**是否已支付**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY a.FINPROD_ID,b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.VDATE ASC

SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日期**/ a.PAY_CYCLE AS payCycle, /**支付频率**/
a.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, /*截止日营业日准则*/ a.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, /*支付日营业日准则*/ a.CALC_RULE AS calcRule, /**推算方式**/ a.FIRST_PAY_DATE AS firstPayDate, /**首次支付日**/ a.CASH_UNIT_TYPE AS cashUnitType, /**现金流单位**/ a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ a.PAY_TYPE AS payType,/**支付方式**/ b.BRANCH AS branch,/**分支序号**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1,/**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2 /**现金流二级类型**/ FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/ AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND #{effdateEnd,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.EFF_DATE /**生效日期**/
AND ( EXISTS( /**筛选：查询查询日最近一条现金流支付规则。**/ SELECT 'X' FROM ( SELECT c.CASH_ID,max(c.EFF_DATE) AS maxEffDate FROM FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE c WHERE c.EFF_DATE<= #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY c.CASH_ID ) d WHERE d.CASH_ID = a.CASH_ID AND d.maxEffDate = a.EFF_DATE ) OR a.EFF_DATE >= #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} )
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.EFF_DATE ASC

SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日期**/ a.CALC_TYPE AS calcType, /**计算类型**/
a.YIELD AS yield, /**生效利率**/ a.BASIS AS basis, /**计息基础**/ a.BASE_TYPE AS baseType, /**基数类型**/ a.BASE_DATE_TYPE AS baseDateType, /**基数日期类型**/ a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ a.REMARK AS remark, /**备注**/ b.BRANCH AS branch, /**分支序号**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2 /**现金流二级类型**/ FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b ON a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/ AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND #{effdateEnd,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.EFF_DATE /**生效日期**/
AND ( EXISTS( /**筛选：查询查询日最近一条现金流计算规则。**/ SELECT 'X' FROM ( SELECT c.CASH_ID,max(c.EFF_DATE) AS maxEffDate FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE c WHERE c.EFF_DATE <=#{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY c.CASH_ID ) d WHERE d.CASH_ID = a.CASH_ID AND d.maxEffDate = a.EFF_DATE ) OR a.EFF_DATE>= #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} )
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.EFF_DATE ASC

SELECT b.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ b.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2, /**现金流二级类型**/ b.BRANCH AS branch, /**分支序号**/ a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.ACCR_DATE AS accrDate, /**计提日**/ a.VAL_DATE AS valDate /**调整前结束日**/ ,a.ACCR_STR_DATE accrStrDate /**区间开始日**/ ,a.ACCR_END_DATE accrEndDate /**区间结束日**/ FROM FIN_FLOAT_ACCRUAL_SCHE a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b ON a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/ AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND a.ACCR_DATE >= #{effdateEnd,jdbcType=DATE} AND a.ACCR_STR_DATE < #{effdateEnd,jdbcType=DATE}
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY b.FINPROD_ID,a.CASH_ID,a.ACCR_DATE ASC

SELECT b.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ b.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2, /**现金流二级类型**/ b.BRANCH AS branch, /**分支序号**/ a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日期**/ a.ACCR_TYPE AS accrType, /**计提类型**/ a.ACCR_CYCLE AS accrCycle, /**计提频率**/ a.ACCR_CYCLE_UNIT AS accrCycleUnit, /**计提频率单位**/ a.ACCR_DAY_TYPE AS accrDayType, /**计提频率类型**/ a.ACCR_DAY_VALUE AS accrDayValue, /**计提频率值**/ a.ACCR_TDAY_RULE AS accrTdayRule, /**计提营业日准则**/ a.F_ACCR_DATE AS fAccrDate,/**首次计提日**/ a.E_ACCR_DATE AS eAccrDate, /**计提结束日**/ a.FIRST_BASE_TYPE AS firstBaseType /**首次计费基数**/ FROM FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b ON a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/ AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND #{effdateEnd,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.EFF_DATE /**生效日期**/
AND ( EXISTS( /**筛选：查询查询日最近一条业务报酬规则。**/ SELECT 'X' FROM ( SELECT c.CASH_ID,max(c.EFF_DATE) AS maxEffDate FROM FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE c WHERE #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} >= c.EFF_DATE GROUP BY c.CASH_ID ) d WHERE d.CASH_ID = a.CASH_ID AND d.maxEffDate = a.EFF_DATE ) OR a.EFF_DATE >= #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} )
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY b.FINPROD_ID,b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.EFF_DATE ASC

SELECT b.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ b.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2, /**现金流二级类型**/ b.BRANCH AS branch, /**分支序号**/ a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日期**/ a.BASE_RULE AS baseRule,/**业绩基准规则**/ a.AST_VDATE_TYPE AS astVdateType,/**资产净值日类型**/ a.ACT_RULE AS actRule,/**生效规则**/ a.BASE_TYPE baseType,/**基数类型**/ a.BASE_DATE_TYPE baseDateType,/**基数日期类型**/ a.BASIS basis/**计息基础**/ FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b ON a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**金融产品代码**/ AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流一级类型**/
AND b.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流二级类型**/
AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} /**现金流代码**/
AND #{effdateEnd,jdbcType=DATE} >= a.EFF_DATE /**生效日期**/
AND ( EXISTS( /**筛选：查询查询日最近一条业务报酬规则。**/ SELECT 'X' FROM ( SELECT c.CASH_ID,max(c.EFF_DATE) AS maxEffDate FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE c WHERE #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} >= c.EFF_DATE GROUP BY c.CASH_ID ) d WHERE d.CASH_ID = a.CASH_ID AND d.maxEffDate = a.EFF_DATE ) OR a.EFF_DATE >= #{effdateStart,jdbcType=DATE} )
AND B.BRANCH = #{branch}/**分支序号**/
ORDER BY b.FINPROD_ID,b.CASH_TYPE_1,b.CASH_TYPE_2,a.EFF_DATE ASC

SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ a.EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日期**/ a.LEV AS "LEVEL", /**层级**/ a.BASE_RULE_ID AS basicRate, /**基准利率**/ a."COEFFICIENT", /**调整系数**/ a.SPREAD_RATE AS spreadRate, /**利差**/ a.CHARGE_RATIO AS chargeRatio, /**银行收取比例**/ a.SALE_RATIO AS saleRatio, /**研发部门收取比例**/ intRateInfo.intRate as /**基准利率**/ FROM FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE_DETAIL a left join (SELECT INT_RATE_ID AS intRateId, /**行情代码**/ EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日**/ INT_RATE AS intRate /**利率**/ FROM (SELECT rateInfo.INT_RATE_ID, rateInfo.EFF_DATE, rateInfo.INT_RATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY rateInfo.INT_RATE_ID ORDER BY rateInfo.EFF_DATE desc) AS rn FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO rateInfo WHERE rateInfo.EFF_DATE <=#{effDate} ORDER BY rateInfo.EFF_DATE desc) WHERE rn = 1) intRateInfo on intRateInfo.intRateId = a.base_rule_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.CASH_ID = #{cashId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.EFF_DATE = #{effDate,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY "LEVEL" ASC

SELECT b.BRANCH_TYPE AS branchType, /**分支类型**/ b.CHL_AGRT_ID AS chlAgrtId, /**通道代码**/ b.PRIN AS prin, /**名义本金**/ b.CCY AS ccy, /**本金币种**/ b.VDATE AS vdate, /**起息日**/ b.MDATE AS mdate, /**到期日**/ b.TERM AS term, /**期限(天)**/ b.INT_TYPE AS intType, /**利率类型**/ b.INT_RATE AS intRate, /**固定利率**/ b.INT_RATE_ID AS intRateId, /**利率编号**/ b.BASIS AS basis, /**计息基础**/ b.M_PRIN_AMT AS mPrinAmt, /**到期本金**/ b.M_INT_AMT AS mIntAmt, /**到期利息**/ b.M_TRADE_AMT AS mTradeAmt, /**到期金额**/ b.O_FINPROD_ID AS oFinprodId, /**原金融产品代码**/
b.FINPROD_TYPE AS oFinprodType, /**原金融产品类型**/ /** modify by jiangpeng on 20210425 ZGBSSE-131 债券借贷融出，理财账有误，费用科目未出账 **/ case when d.REGIST_ORG is null then TPD.REGIST_ORG else d.REGIST_ORG end AS registOrg, /**登记托管机构**/
c.TYPE_1 AS type1,/**分类1**/ c.TYPE_2 AS type2,/**分类2**/ c.TYPE_3 AS type3,/**分类3**/ c.TYPE_4 AS type4,/**分类4**/ c.TYPE_5 AS type5,/**分类5**/ c.TYPE_6 AS type6, /**分类6**/ b.trade_market tradeMarket, /*交易所*/ d.opt_fee_amt optFeeAmt,/**期权费 add by yanya on 20200208**/ e.se_rep_day_type seRepDayType,/*交易所回购计提天数方式*/ b.vpay_date vpayDate,/*首期交付日*/ b.mpay_date mpayDate,/*到期交付日*/ b.act_cap_days actCapDays, /*实际资金占用天数*/ b.EXC_PS excPs /*外汇交易方向*/ FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT b LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE c ON c.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID
LEFT JOIN FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD d ON d.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID /** add by jiangpeng on 20210425 ZGBSSE-131 债券借贷融出，理财账有误，费用科目未出账 **/ LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD ON TPD.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID AND TPD.IS_CANCEL='N' /** add by jiangpeng on 20210425 ZGBSSE-131 债券借贷融出，理财账有误，费用科目未出账 **/ /** 取消该条件 by yanya on 20200208 AND d.FINPROD_TYPE = b.FINPROD_TYPE **/ AND b.BRANCH = d.BRANCH left join fin_product_valuation_para e on b.finprod_id=e.finprod_id and b.branch=e.branch WHERE b.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND b.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND b.BRANCH = #{branch}

SELECT INT_RATE_ID AS intRateId, /**行情代码**/ EFF_DATE AS effDate, /**生效日**/ INT_RATE AS intRate /**利率**/ FROM ( SELECT INT_RATE_ID, EFF_DATE, INT_RATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INT_RATE_ID ORDER BY EFF_DATE desc) AS rn FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO WHERE EFF_DATE <=#{selectDate} AND INT_RATE_ID = #{intRateId} ORDER BY EFF_DATE desc ) WHERE rn = 1

SELECT VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, NETPRICE AS price,
PRICE AS allPrice,
VALUE_SOURCE AS valueSource FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO WHERE SEC_ID = #{marketCode} AND VALUE_DATE <= #{queryDate} AND VALUE_SOURCE = #{valueSource} AND NETPRICE != 0 AND NETPRICE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC

SELECT VALUE_DATE AS valueDate,
CLOSE_PRICE AS closePrice, AVERAGE_PRICE AS averagePrice, MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, MIN_PRICE AS minPrice, BUY_ONE_PRICE AS buyOnePrice, SELL_ONE_PRICE AS sellOnePric, CLOSE_PRICE_FULL AS closePriceFull, /**收盘价全价**/ AVERAGE_PRICE_FULL AS averagePriceFull, /**平均价**/ MAX_PRICE_FULL AS maxPriceFull, /**最高价全价**/ MIN_PRICE_FULL AS minPriceFull, /**最低价全价**/ BUY_ONE_PRICE_FULL AS buyOnePriceFull, /**买一价全价**/ SELL_ONE_PRICE_FULL AS sellOnePricFull /**卖一价全价**/ FROM MST_BOND_MARKET_INFO WHERE SEC_ID = #{marketCode}
AND CLOSE_PRICE != 0 AND CLOSE_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND AVERAGE_PRICE != 0 AND AVERAGE_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND MAX_PRICE != 0 AND MAX_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND MIN_PRICE != 0 AND MIN_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND BUY_ONE_PRICE != 0 AND BUY_ONE_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND SELL_ONE_PRICE != 0 AND SELL_ONE_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND VALUE_DATE <= #{queryDate} ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC

SELECT VAL_DATE AS valDate, VALUATION AS valuation FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION WHERE 1=1 AND FINPROD_ID = #{marketCode} AND VAL_DATE <= #{queryDate} AND VALUATION != 0 AND VALUATION IS NOT NULL AND (PUBLISH_DATE is null or PUBLISH_DATE <= #{queryDate}) ORDER BY VAL_DATE DESC
SELECT VAL_DATE AS valDate, VALUATION AS valuation FROM FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{marketCode} AND FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND VAL_DATE <= #{queryDate} ORDER BY VAL_DATE DESC

SELECT FUND_CODE AS fundCode,
VALUE_DATE AS valueDate, CLOSE_PRICE AS closePrice, AVERAGE_PRICE AS averagePrice, MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, MIN_PRICE AS minPrice, BUY_ONE_PRICE AS buyOnePrice, SELL_ONE_PRICE AS sellOnePrice FROM MST_FUND_MARKET_INFO WHERE FUND_CODE = #{marketCode}
AND CLOSE_PRICE != 0 AND CLOSE_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND AVERAGE_PRICE != 0 AND AVERAGE_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND MAX_PRICE != 0 AND MAX_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND MIN_PRICE != 0 AND MIN_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND BUY_ONE_PRICE != 0 AND BUY_ONE_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND SELL_ONE_PRICE != 0 AND SELL_ONE_PRICE IS NOT NULL
AND VALUE_DATE <= #{queryDate} ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC

SELECT a.CASH_ID AS cashId, /**现金流代码**/ b.CASH_TYPE_1 AS cashType1, /**现金流一级类型**/ b.CASH_TYPE_2 AS cashType2, /**现金流二级类型**/ a.VDATE AS vdate, /**计息开始日**/ a.MDATE AS mdate, /**计息结束日**/ a.VDATE_Y AS vdateY, /**计息年度开始日，A/A_BOND适用**/ a.PAY_DATE AS payDate, /**计划支付日**/ a.CASH_AMT AS cashAmt, /**计划现金流**/ a.CASH_UNIT_TYPE AS cashUnitType, /**现金流单位，百元、 发行规模**/ a.CALC_FUNCTION AS calcFunction, /**计息算法，分摊法、累计法**/ a.FREQUENCY AS frequency, /**年付息次数**/ a.FINPROD_ID AS finprodId, /**金融产品代码**/ a.FINPROD_TYPE AS finprodType, /**金融产品类型**/ a.PAY_TYPE AS payType, /**支付方式，现金、红利再投等**/ --a.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, /**是否已支付**/ a.VDATE_TERM as vdateTerm, /**完整区间开始日**/ a.MDATE_TERM as theoryTerm, /**完整区间结束日**/ a.TERMDAYS as termdays, /**完整区间计息天数**/ a.VDATE_UNADJUST AS vdateUnadjust,/**未调整的计算开始日**/ a.MDATE_UNADJUST AS mdateUnadjust/**未调整的计算结束日**/ FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN a LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO b ON a.cash_id = b.cash_id WHERE b.FINPROD_ID = #{busiId} AND a.VDATE <= #{happenDate} AND a.MDATE > #{happenDate} AND b.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType}

SELECT VALUE_DATE, NETPRICE FROM( SELECT VALUE_DATE,
NETPRICE, VALUE_SOURCE FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO WHERE SEC_ID = #{secId} AND VALUE_DATE <= #{valueDate} AND VALUE_SOURCE = #{valueSource} ORDER BY VALUE_DATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT plan.CASH_ID, plan.CASH_NUM, plan.VDATE_UNADJUST, plan.MDATE_UNADJUST, plan.PAY_DATE_UNADJUST, plan.VDATE, plan.MDATE, plan.PAY_DATE, plan.TERMDAYS, plan.VDATE_Y, plan.VDATE_TERM, plan.MDATE_TERM, plan.TERMDAYS_TERM, plan.PRIN_AMT, plan.INT_PRIN_AMT, plan.INT_AMT, plan.IS_PAY_INT, plan.CASH_AMT, plan.CASH_UNIT_TYPE, plan.CALC_FUNCTION, plan.FREQUENCY, plan.FINPROD_ID, plan.FINPROD_TYPE, plan.BRANCH, plan.PAY_TYPE, plan.CREATE_USER, plan.CREATE_DEPT, plan.CREATE_TIME, plan.UPDATE_USER, plan.UPDATE_TIME, info.CASH_TYPE_1 FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN plan, FIN_CASH_INFO info WHERE info.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND info.CASH_ID = plan.CASH_ID AND plan.MDATE = #{mdate}

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_TYPE, A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME, A.PROFIT_TYPE, A.COUPON_SPECIES, A.CHL_FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, A.ISSUE_PRICE, A.ISSUE_AMT, A.CCY, A.BLN_AREA, A.TRADE_MARKET, A.CALENDAR_ID, A.ISSUE_TYPE, A.ISSUER, A.IDATE, A.VDATE, A.MDATE, A.ACTMDATE, A.IS_CHL, A.IS_SUS, A.IS_RIGHT, A.P_FINPROD_ID, A.O_FINPROD_ID, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE FROM BOK_BOOKSET B INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT A ON B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = A.FINPROD_ID WHERE B.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = #{acctSubjectType}

SELECT ple.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID, prd.FINPROD_TYPE AS pledgeFinprodType, ple.PLEDGE_NUMBER, prd.TRADE_MARKET, prd.REGIST_ORG FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fin INNER JOIN FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE ple ON fin.FINPROD_ID = ple.FINPROD_ID /** AND fin.FINPROD_TYPE = ple.FINPROD_TYPE **/ AND fin.BRANCH = ple.BRANCH LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT prd ON ple.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = prd.FINPROD_ID /** AND ple.PLEDGE_FINPROD_TYPE = prd.FINPROD_TYPE **/ WHERE fin.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND fin.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND fin.BRANCH_TYPE is null AND fin.BRANCH = 0

select A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, A.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, A.VAL_DATE as valDate, A.VALUATION as valuation, A.INPUT_TYPE as inputType from FIN_PRODUCT_VALUATION A where A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and A.VAL_DATE = #{valDate}

SELECT distinct A.FINPROD_ID chlId, NVL(A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME) chlName, b.COLLECT_TYPE collectType FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO FCI ON A.FINPROD_ID = FCI.CHL_FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP ON FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.IS_CHL = 'Y' AND A.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F28' /** 通道 F28**/ AND FCI.CHL_LEVEL = 1 AND FP.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
SELECT VAL_DATE valDate, VALUATION valuation, CCY ccy FROM MST_VAL_OP WHERE FINPROD_ID2 = #{finprodId} AND VAL_DATE <= #{happenDate} ORDER BY VAL_DATE DESC
select is_pay_int from fin_cash_plan where finprod_id = #{finprodId} and cash_type in ('02','03') and rownum=1

SELECT A.Finprod_Id finprodId,B.BOK_DETAIL_ID bokDetailId FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_BARTER A LEFT JOIN BOK_DETAIL_ID B ON B.BUSI_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND B.BUSI_DETAIL_TYPE = A.FINPROD_TYPE AND A.INV_AIM = B.INV_AIM left join trd_product_deal_add tpda on A.TRADE_ID = tpda.trade_id and B.BOOKSET_ID = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F16}||tpda.portfolio_id left join trd_product_deal_add tpda1 on A.TRADE_ID = tpda1.trade_id and B.BOOKSET_ID = tpda1.portfolio_id WHERE A.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND nvl(tpda1.portfolio_id,tpda.portfolio_id)=#{portfolioId}
select finprod_type2 from fin_cash_plan where finprod_id = #{finprodId} and rownum=1
